<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/v1/modules/available_repos"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



This call returns each repository that a connected git source of the workspace offers. To link a repository to a module, send its `integrationAccountId`, `externalRepoId` and `fullName` to `POST /v1/modules/{moduleId}/repos`. The list has no repository of a personal integration account, because a module belongs to the workspace.
